spans.note: module docstring: title, research question, author, date, plus trailing blank line
suppress warnings and fix numpy random seed for reproducibility
section header: DATA LOADING AND PREPARATION

spans.operation: load the raw soccer referee-player dyad dataset from a fixed CSV path as the full analytic universe

spans.note: section header: SKIN TONE VARIABLE CONSTRUCTION

spans.operation: average the two raters' skin-tone scores into a single continuous skin_tone_avg measure
drop dyads with missing average skin-tone score from the analytic sample
restrict to dyads with both ratings present and compute Pearson/Spearman correlation and exact agreement between the two raters as an inter-rater reliability check
collapse the red-card count into a binary any-red-card outcome
dichotomize skin tone into dark vs light using a 0.25 cutoff chosen from exploratory analysis
log-transform games played to reduce skew before using it as a covariate
impute missing height and weight with the sample median
collapse free-text position labels into five coarse position categories via keyword matching, defaulting unmatched or missing values to Unknown

spans.note: alias the prepared dataframe as the final modeling dataset
subset the modeling dataframe into light-skin and dark-skin groups using the already-defined dark_skin category, purely for descriptive reporting
section header: PRIMARY ANALYSIS - ADJUSTED RISK DIFFERENCE

spans.operation: specify and fit the primary logistic regression of any_red_card on dark_skin adjusted for log_games, position, league country, yellow cards, height and weight
choose average marginal effects (overall) as the estimator used to turn the logit fit into a risk-difference scale
pull the dark_skin effect, its SE, p-value and CI out of the marginal-effects object via a hardcoded array index position

spans.note: section header: SECONDARY ANALYSIS - ADJUSTED ODDS RATIO

spans.operation: exponentiate the dark_skin logit coefficient and its CI to report an adjusted odds ratio as a secondary estimand

spans.note: narrative recap of outcome, predictor, covariates and estimation method already decided above

spans.operation: refit the primary-style model across a range of alternative skin-tone cutoffs (0.125-0.75) to test sensitivity of the risk difference to the threshold choice
refit with a minimal covariate set (exposure only) to test sensitivity of the effect to the adjustment set
re-specify skin tone as a continuous predictor instead of the binary indicator and fit via OLS with HC1 robust standard errors
drop dyads with only one game played and refit the primary model to check sensitivity to low-exposure dyads
declare the hypothesis supported using a two-sided p<0.05 threshold on the primary marginal effect combined with a positive-direction check, and phrase the reported conclusion accordingly
